claims.originalText: From the finely proportioned body to the elaborate decoration cast with great precision, this ritual wine vessel displays the artistic refinement and technical virtuosity that marked the full blossoming of late Shang bronze art.

qualifiers.attribution: The Cleveland Museum of Art; captured record, not independent authentication
qualifiers.editorialScope: Object-specific or explicitly bounded comparison; no certificate implied

variants.text: From the finely proportioned body to the elaborate decoration cast with great precision, this ritual wine vessel displays the artistic refinement and technical virtuosity that marked the full blossoming of late Shang bronze art.

claims.originalText: Although the monsterlike masks that project from each leg display animal imagery common on older bronzes, the two registers of hooked, ribbonlike bands that encircle the bowl preserve only traces of early dragon or bird patterns.
